text_block_list.text:
One thing after another had piled up into a mountain of work.
Thinking I had to clear it before it became unmanageable, I ended up sacrificing my sleep to deal with it, but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Trainer~. Did you perhaps not get much rest last night either~?
choice_data_list: The deadline's coming up... I have no choice but to get it done

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: (My goodness... Being a Trainer truly is hard work~)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
! Indeed.
I shall simply soothe away
Trainer-sama's fatigue~.

"...Unable to gather my thoughts, my hands came to a stop.
It was right around that time that it began."
A faint, sweet aroma drifting from somewhere.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
How do you like it~?
It's a special aroma blend favored by the Mejiro family~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Rosemary improves circulation
and relieves stiffness and fatigue~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
The soothing effect of frankincense alleviates impatience and anxiety.
This will help relieve mental fatigue~.

In other words—it seems Mejiro Bright was trying to
ease our fatigue.
Or, so it seems, but...
choice_data_list: (This tranquility... it's too powerful...!)

text_block_list.text:
Because recovery was accelerated, my body grew
even more relaxed, and the drowsiness hit harder.

There is definitely a benefit to this... However,
that doesn't mean I can just fall asleep here.

Pinching my thigh to fight off the drowsiness,
I managed to endure—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: How was it~?
choice_data_list: M-Maybe I relaxed a little too much...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"My.
I must be more careful next time, then~."
choice_data_list: (—Will there be a next time…?)

text_block_list.text:
...A quiet, gentle melody began to play.
This is... classical music.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, let us relax those shoulders~.
This is a masterpiece by the Mejiro family's retained composer.
Indeed, one often hears that such music alleviates mental fatigue, and I do feel its effects from this track as well, but—
choice_data_list: (Once the fatigue fades, drowsiness will follow...)

text_block_list.text:
I want to recover from this fatigue, but I can't fall asleep.
In order to pull off this tightrope walk—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
My, Trainer-sama.
Your eyes are wide open, completely round.
They're going to dry out, you know~.
choice_data_list: (Whoaaaaaaaaaa...!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Fufu, shall we have some tea soon~?
"...Third time's the charm. If I get some caffeine in me, the sleepiness should—"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
It's the Mejiro family's special blend with a chamomile and sage tea base♪
Please, enjoy a cup renowned for relieving fatigue~
choice_data_list: (Ah, so it was herbal tea!)

text_block_list.text:
Neither herb contains caffeine.
Though we might be able to expect some accelerated fatigue recovery...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I studied the best way to brew this.
Please, enjoy.
choice_data_list: (I want to relieve my fatigue, but getting sleepy would be bad.)

text_block_list.text:
I'll endure Mejiro Bright's full course of relaxation and reap only the benefits of fatigue recovery!
Steeling my resolve—
choice_data_list: I'll resist with all my might...!
I might not be able to hold out.

text_block_list.text:
Taking advantage of the moment their gaze shifts away, I pull out
an ultra-spicy snack meant to stave off drowsiness from my desk
and pop it into my mouth.
choice_data_list: Aaaaaaaagh!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"My. Is something the matter?
Could it be... the tea was not to your liking?"
choice_data_list: I-It was so good I gulped it down, but it was scorching hot...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu.
You really are a clumsy one, aren't you~
choice_data_list: And the music just makes my body itch to move...!
And the music just makes my body itch to move...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"My. Shaking your head so vigorously...
The rhythm can be much slower, you know~."
choice_data_list: (This will blow the sleepiness right away...!)

text_block_list.text:
At the end of a long struggle, the music had stopped playing.
I had also drained every last drop of the tea that had been served.
choice_data_list: (What a strange sense of accomplishment...)

text_block_list.text:
The moment that thought arose, all strength seemed to drain
from a body enveloped in a sense of peaceful relief...

It seems I dozed off for just a brief moment.
Letting my guard down must have caused it.
choice_data_list: ...I have to get back to work.

text_block_list.text:
I rush back to the computer and resume working.
And then—

My thoughts came together surprisingly smoothly, and the words began to flow effortlessly.
The fatigue recovery seemed to have made a huge difference.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Looks like the fatigue has cleared right off your face~.
I'm so glad.
choice_data_list: Thank you... Now I can do my best again.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... If you get tired, I would be
more than happy to assist you again~.
And so, thanks to Mejiro Bright, I was somehow able to finish up all the paperwork.
Even so, I couldn't just abandon my work. Though I resisted for a while—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Once your fatigue is relieved, your work is bound to proceed much more smoothly.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
...Oh my~?
Trainer-sama~?
That gentle voice acted like a lullaby, making my eyelids grow heavy...
choice_data_list: I can't... take it anymore...

text_block_list.text: My consciousness drifted into slumber.

I suddenly wake up.
Looking at the clock, it seems I've been asleep for two hours.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Hrmmm...
choice_data_list: Whoa, Bright!?

text_block_list.text: Looking at the opposite sofa, Mejiro Bright was sleeping peacefully. I wonder if she fell asleep right after carrying me over here.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Trainer...-samaaa...
Please take... care of your—
choice_data_list: I feel like I've made you fuss over me quite a bit.
I feel like I've made you fuss over me quite a bit.

text_block_list.text:
Resuming work, I notice a dramatic improvement
in my cognitive performance.
Perhaps rest was necessary after all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: *Yaaawn*... Good morning~.
choice_data_list: Good morning. I'm feeling better thanks to Bright.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh... fufu, I am so glad to hear that~.
I would be happy to lend a hand anytime~.
